description.message: Send selected download links to Mulee on this Mac for confirmation.

chooseLinks.message: Choose links to send to Mulee.

empty.message: No download links found. You can also right-click a link to download with Mulee.

takeoverHint.message: Off by default. Enabling requests download access and optional request method access. Downloads pause first and resume if handoff fails or takes more than 10 seconds.

takeoverUnavailable.message: This browser does not provide the download interception API. Use the context menu or select links to send to Mulee.

extensions.message: File extensions to intercept (spaces or commas)

confirmHint.message: Links open in Mulee on this Mac. Downloads start only after you confirm.

sent.message: Sent to Mulee. Confirm the download in Mulee.

sendFailed.message: Could not open Mulee. Make sure Mulee is installed and open, or temporarily disable interception and retry.

tooLarge.message: A link or the selected text exceeds 1 MiB. Reduce the selection and retry.

restrictedPage.message: This page does not allow extensions to read it. Try a regular webpage.

permissionDenied.message: Download permission was not granted. Interception remains off.

externalPrompt.message: Choose “Open Mulee” in the browser prompt. You can select “Always allow”. This temporary tab closes when you return to the browser; close it manually if you cancel.

videoLogin.message: Share Bilibili / YouTube sign-in with Mulee to download quality options that require sign-in

videoLoginHint.message: Cookies are read only from these two sites after you enable this option. For Chrome, first click “Allow the Chrome extension to share sign-in” in Mulee’s Video settings. Clear saved sign-in in Mulee after turning this off.

videoLoginNotFound.message: No Bilibili or YouTube sign-in found. Sign in to either site in your browser first.

videoLoginReloadRequired.message: Reload the Mulee extension at chrome://extensions, then try again.

videoLoginFailed.message: Unable to share sign-in. For Chrome, click “Allow the Chrome extension to share sign-in” in Mulee’s Video settings. For Safari, use a signed release of Mulee.

downloadCookies.message: Allow Mulee to read sign-in for this website

downloadCookiesHint.message: Off by default. Only cookies for explicitly allowed download websites are sent to Mulee through Native Messaging. Cookies never enter links or task history. For Chrome, enable native handoff in Mulee’s Video settings first.

downloadCookiesUnavailable.message: This page cannot grant website sign-in access.

downloadCookiesDenied.message: Website permission was not granted. Sign-in sharing remains off.

downloadCookiesFailed.message: Could not share website sign-in. Check the native handoff setup in Mulee and retry.

excludedSites.message: Websites to leave in the browser

excludedSitesHint.message: Enter domains separated by spaces, commas or new lines. *.example.com matches subdomains only. A matching source page or download address stays in the browser.

invalidExcludedSites.message: Enter domains or *.example.com, without a scheme or path.

methodPermissionDenied.message: Request method access was not granted. Matching downloads will still be intercepted. Downloads that submit forms may not work in Mulee.

handoffTimeout.message: Handoff was not confirmed within 10 seconds. The extension tried to resume the browser download.

nativeTakeoverHint.message: Install the Chrome helper in Mulee’s Video settings and allow native access to keep downloads in the browser when Mulee is not running. Without the helper, the browser handoff page cannot confirm receipt by Mulee.
